title: MA41108: Statistical Inference
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Parametric point estimation, unbiasedness, consistency, efficiency, invariance,
method of moments and maximum likelihood, lower bounds for the variance of an
estimator, Frechet-Rao-Cramer, Bhattacharya, Chapman-Robbins-Kiefer
inequalities. Sufficiency, minimal sufficiency, Factorization Theorem, RaoBlackwell Theorem, completeness, Lehmann-Scheffe Theorem, Basu s Theorem.Tests
of hypotheses, simple and composite hypotheses, types of error, Neyman-Pearson
Lemma, families with monotone likelihood ratio, UMP, UMP unbiased and UMP
invariant tests. Likelihood ratio tests-applications to one sample and two
sample problems, Chi-square tests. Sequential probability ratio test.Interval
estimation- methods for finding confidence intervals, shortest length
confidence intervals.
